L.isg: ^℟.^ Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
L.9lr: ^3:2^ Dómine, quid multiplicáti sunt qui tríbulant me? * multi insúrgunt advérsum me.
L.9lx: ^3:3^ Multi dicunt ánimæ meæ: * Non est salus ipsi in Deo ejus.
L.9m3: ^3:4^ Tu autem, Dómine, suscéptor meus es, * glória mea, et exáltans caput meum.
L.9m5: ^3:5^ Voce mea ad Dóminum clamávi: * et exaudívit me de monte sancto suo.
L.9m8: ^3:6^ Ego dormívi, et soporátus sum: * et exsurréxi, quia Dóminus suscépit me.
L.9mb: ^3:7^ Non timébo míllia pópuli circumdántis me: * exsúrge, Dómine, salvum me fac, Deus meus.
L.9mf: ^3:8^ Quóniam tu percussísti omnes adversántes mihi sine causa: * dentes peccatórum contrivísti.
L.9mi: ^3:9^ Dómini est salus: * et super pópulum tuum benedíctio tua.
L.k6r: ^℣.^ O God, come to my assistance;
L.j5h: ^℟.^ O Lord, make haste to help me.
L.k75: ^℣.^ O Lord, open thou my lips.
L.ihk: ^℟.^ And my mouth shall declare thy praise.
L.9lv: ^3:2^ Why, O Lord, are they multiplied that afflict me? * many are they who rise up against me.
L.9lw: ^3:3^ Many say to my soul: * There is no salvation for him in his God.
L.9ly: ^3:4^ But thou, O Lord art my protector, * my glory, and the lifter up of my head.
L.9m4: ^3:5^ I have cried to the Lord with my voice: * and he hath heard me from his holy hill.
L.9m9: ^3:6^ I have slept and taken my rest: * and I have risen up, because the Lord hath protected me.
L.9ma: ^3:7^ I will not fear thousands of the people, surrounding me: * arise, O Lord; save me, O my God.
L.9mc: ^3:8^ For thou hast struck all them who are my adversaries without cause: * thou hast broken the teeth of sinners.
L.9ml: ^3:9^ Salvation is of the Lord: * and thy blessing is upon thy people.
L.10gr: ^Reliqua omittuntur in Officium xij. Lectionum, quas immediatæ subsequuntur Laudes. Sed tam in Feriis, quam in Festis iij. Lectionum, in Hieme et in Æstate semper dicuntur ut sequitur.^

L.nq0: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
L.rdh: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
L.a0c: ^On Simplex feasts and on ferial days, and if Matins are separate from Lauds, one begins in silence:^
L.npy: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.
L.lyf: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
L.9ot: ^66:2^ Deus misereátur nostri, et benedícat nobis: * illúminet vultum suum super nos, et misereátur nostri.
L.9ow: ^66:3^ Ut cognoscámus in terra viam tuam, * in ómnibus géntibus salutáre tuum.
L.9ox: ^66:4^ Confiteántur tibi pópuli, Deus: * confiteántur tibi pópuli omnes.
L.9p0: ^66:5^ Læténtur et exsúltent gentes: * quóniam júdicas pópulos in æquitáte, et gentes in terra dírigis.
L.9p1: ^66:6^ Confiteántur tibi pópuli, Deus, confiteántur tibi pópuli omnes: * terra dedit fructum suum.
L.9p3: ^66:7^ Benedícat nos Deus, Deus noster, benedícat nos Deus: * et métuant eum omnes fines terræ.
L.9ou: ^66:2^ May God have mercy on us, and bless us: * may he cause the light of his countenance to shine upon us, and may he have mercy on us.
L.9ov: ^66:3^ That we may know thy way upon earth: * thy salvation in all nations.
L.9oy: ^66:4^ Let people confess to thee, O God: * let all people give praise to thee.
L.9oz: ^66:5^ Let the nations be glad and rejoice: * for thou judgest the people with justice, and directest the nations upon earth.
L.9p2: ^66:6^ Let the people, O God, confess to thee: * let all the people give praise to thee: the earth hath yielded her fruit.
L.9p4: ^66:7^ May God, our God bless us, may God bless us: * and all the ends of the earth fear him.
L.9od: ^62:2^ Deus, Deus meus, * ad te de luce vígilo.
L.9og: ^62:2^ Sitívit in te ánima mea, * quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.
L.9oi: ^62:3^ In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: * sic in sancto appárui tibi, ut vidérem virtútem tuam, et glóriam tuam.
L.9ok: ^62:4^ Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: * lábia mea laudábunt te.
L.9ol: ^62:5^ Sic benedícam te in vita mea: * et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.
L.9oo: ^62:6^ Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: * et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.
L.9oq: ^62:7^ Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, in matutínis meditábor in te: * quia fuísti adjútor meus.
L.9os: ^62:8^ Et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo, adhǽsit ánima mea post te: * me suscépit déxtera tua.
L.9oa: ^62:10^ Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, introíbunt in inferióra terræ: * tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.
L.9oc: ^62:12^ Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, laudabúntur omnes qui jurant in eo: * quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.
L.9of: ^62:2^ O God, my God, * to thee do I watch at break of day.
L.9oe: ^62:2^ For thee my soul hath thirsted; * for thee my flesh, O how many ways!
L.9oh: ^62:3^ In a desert land, and where there is no way, and no water: * so in the sanctuary have I come before thee, to see thy power and thy glory.
L.9oj: ^62:4^ For thy mercy is better than lives: * thee my lips shall praise.
L.9om: ^62:5^ Thus will I bless thee all my life long: * and in thy name I will lift up my hands.
L.9on: ^62:6^ Let my soul be filled as with marrow and fatness: * and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips.
L.9op: ^62:7^ If I have remembered thee upon my bed, I will meditate on thee in the morning: * because thou hast been my helper.
L.9or: ^62:8^ And I will rejoice under the covert of thy wings: my soul hath stuck close to thee: * thy right hand hath received me.
L.9o9: ^62:10^ But they have sought my soul in vain, they shall go into the lower parts of the earth: * they shall be delivered into the hands of the sword, they shall be the portions of foxes.
L.9ob: ^62:12^ But the king shall rejoice in God, all they shall be praised that swear by him: * because the mouth is stopped of them that speak wicked things.
L.uad: ^3:57^ Benedícite, ómnia ópera Dómini, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
L.uae: ^3:58^ Benedícite, Ángeli Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, cœli, Dómino.
L.uag: ^3:59^ Benedícite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cœlos sunt, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.
L.uai: ^3:60^ Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: * benedícite, stellæ cœli, Dómino.
L.uak: ^3:61^ Benedícite, omnis imber et ros, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes spíritus Dei, Dómino.
L.uam: ^3:62^ Benedícite, ignis et æstus, Dómino: * benedícite, frigus et æstus, Dómino.
L.uao: ^3:63^ Benedícite, rores et pruína, Dómino: * benedícite, gelu et frigus, Dómino.
L.uaq: ^3:64^ Benedícite, glácies et nives, Dómino: * benedícite, noctes et dies, Dómino.
L.uas: ^3:65^ Benedícite, lux et ténebræ, Dómino: * benedícite, fúlgura et nubes, Dómino.
L.uau: ^3:66^ Benedícat terra Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
L.uaw: ^3:67^ Benedícite, montes et colles, Dómino: * benedícite, univérsa germinántia in terra, Dómino.
L.uay: ^3:68^ Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: * benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.
L.ub0: ^3:69^ Benedícite, cete, et ómnia, quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes vólucres cœli, Dómino.
L.ub2: ^3:70^ Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: * benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.
L.ub4: ^3:71^ Benedícat Israël Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
L.ub6: ^3:72^ Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.
L.ub8: ^3:73^ Benedícite, spíritus, et ánimæ justórum, Dómino: * benedícite, sancti, et húmiles corde, Dómino.
L.uba: ^3:74^ Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
L.ubd: ^3:75^ ^(Fit reverentia:)^ Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu: * laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.
L.uaa: ^3:56^ Benedíctus es, Dómine, in firmaménto cœli: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.
L.uac: ^3:57^ All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.
L.uaf: ^3:58^ O ye angels of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye heavens, bless the Lord:
L.uah: ^3:59^ O all ye waters that are above the heavens, bless the Lord: * O all ye powers of the Lord, bless the Lord.
L.uaj: ^3:60^ O ye sun and moon, bless the Lord: * O ye stars of heaven, bless the Lord.
L.ual: ^3:61^ O every shower and dew, bless ye the Lord: * O all ye spirits of God, bless the Lord.
L.uan: ^3:62^ O ye fire and heat, bless the Lord: * O ye cold and heat, bless the Lord.
L.uap: ^3:63^ O ye dews and hoar frosts, bless the Lord: * O ye frost and cold, bless the Lord.
L.uar: ^3:64^ O ye ice and snow, bless the Lord: * O ye nights and days, bless the Lord.
L.uat: ^3:65^ O ye light and darkness, bless the Lord: * O ye lightnings and clouds, bless the Lord.
L.uav: ^3:66^ O let the earth bless the Lord: * let it praise and exalt him above all for ever.
L.uax: ^3:67^ O ye mountains and hills, bless the Lord: * O all ye things that spring up in the earth, bless the Lord.
L.uaz: ^3:68^ O ye fountains, bless the Lord: * O ye seas and rivers, bless the Lord.
L.ub1: ^3:69^ O ye whales, and all that move in the waters, bless the Lord: * O all ye fowls of the air, bless the Lord.
L.ub3: ^3:70^ O all ye beasts and cattle, bless the Lord: * O ye sons of men, bless the Lord.
L.ub5: ^3:71^ O let Israel bless the Lord: * let them praise and exalt him above all for ever.
L.ub7: ^3:72^ O ye priests of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye servants of the Lord, bless the Lord.
L.ub9: ^3:73^ O ye spirits and souls of the just, bless the Lord: * O ye holy and humble of heart, bless the Lord.
L.ubb: ^3:74^ O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless ye the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.
L.ubc: ^3:75^ ^(Bow head)^ Let us bless the Father and the Son, with the Holy Ghost; * let us praise and exalt him above all for ever.
L.uab: ^3:56^ Blessed art thou, O Lord, in the firmament of heaven: * and worthy of praise, and glorious for ever.
L.9ez: ^148:1^ Laudáte Dóminum de cœlis: * laudáte eum in excélsis.
L.9f1: ^148:2^ Laudáte eum, omnes Ángeli ejus: * laudáte eum, omnes virtútes ejus.
L.9f3: ^148:3^ Laudáte eum, sol et luna: * laudáte eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.
L.9f5: ^148:4^ Laudáte eum, cœli cœlórum: * et aquæ omnes, quæ super cœlos sunt, laudent nomen Dómini.
L.9f8: ^148:5^ Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.
L.9fa: ^148:6^ Státuit ea in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.
L.9fb: ^148:7^ Laudáte Dóminum de terra, * dracónes, et omnes abýssi.
L.9fe: ^148:8^ Ignis, grando, nix, glácies, spíritus procellárum: * quæ fáciunt verbum ejus:
L.9ff: ^148:9^ Montes, et omnes colles: * ligna fructífera, et omnes cedri.
L.9eq: ^148:10^ Béstiæ, et univérsa pécora: * serpéntes, et vólucres pennátæ:
L.9es: ^148:11^ Reges terræ, et omnes pópuli: * príncipes, et omnes júdices terræ.
L.9et: ^148:12^ Júvenes, et vírgines: senes cum junióribus laudent nomen Dómini: * quia exaltátum est nomen ejus solíus.
L.9ew: ^148:14^ Conféssio ejus super cœlum et terram: * et exaltávit cornu pópuli sui.
L.9ex: ^148:14^ Hymnus ómnibus sanctis ejus: * fíliis Israël, pópulo appropinquánti sibi.
L.9f0: ^148:1^ Praise ye the Lord from the heavens * praise ye him in the high places.
L.9f2: ^148:2^ Praise ye him, all his angels: * praise ye him, all his hosts.
L.9f4: ^148:3^ Praise ye him, O sun and moon: * praise him, all ye stars and light.
L.9f6: ^148:4^ Praise him, ye heavens of heavens: * and let all the waters that are above the heavens, praise the name of the Lord.
L.9f7: ^148:5^ For he spoke, and they were made: * he commanded, and they were created.
L.9f9: ^148:6^ He hath established them for ever, and for ages of ages: * he hath made a decree, and it shall not pass away.
L.9fc: ^148:7^ Praise the Lord from the earth, * ye dragons, and all ye deeps:
L.9fd: ^148:8^ Fire, hail, snow, ice, stormy winds * which fulfill his word:
L.9fg: ^148:9^ Mountains and all hills, * fruitful trees and all cedars:
L.9ep: ^148:10^ Beasts and all cattle: * serpents and feathered fowls:
L.9er: ^148:11^ Kings of the earth and all people: * princes and all judges of the earth:
L.9eu: ^148:12^ Young men and maidens: let the old with the younger, praise the name of the Lord: * For his name alone is exalted.
L.9ey: ^148:14^ The praise of him is above heaven and earth: * and he hath exalted the horn of his people.
L.9ev: ^148:14^ A hymn to all his saints: to the children of Israel, a people approaching him.
L.9fh: ^149:1^ Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * laus ejus in ecclésia sanctórum.
L.9fk: ^149:2^ Lætétur Israël in eo, qui fecit eum: * et fílii Sion exsúltent in rege suo.
L.9fl: ^149:3^ Laudent nomen ejus in choro: * in týmpano, et psaltério psallant ei:
L.9fo: ^149:4^ Quia beneplácitum est Dómino in pópulo suo: * et exaltábit mansuétos in salútem.
L.9fp: ^149:5^ Exsultábunt sancti in glória: * lætabúntur in cubílibus suis.
L.9fr: ^149:6^ Exaltatiónes Dei in gútture eórum: * et gládii ancípites in mánibus eórum.
L.9ft: ^149:7^ Ad faciéndam vindíctam in natiónibus: * increpatiónes in pópulis.
L.9fv: ^149:8^ Ad alligándos reges eórum in compédibus: * et nóbiles eórum in mánicis férreis.
L.9fy: ^149:9^ Ut fáciant in eis judícium conscríptum: * glória hæc est ómnibus sanctis ejus.
L.9fi: ^149:1^ Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: * let his praise be in the church of the saints.
L.9fj: ^149:2^ Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: * and let the children of Sion be joyful in their king.
L.9fm: ^149:3^ Let them praise his name in choir: * let them sing to him with the timbrel and the psaltery.
L.9fn: ^149:4^ For the Lord is well pleased with his people: * and he will exalt the meek unto salvation.
L.9fq: ^149:5^ The saints shall rejoice in glory: * they shall be joyful in their beds.
L.9fs: ^149:6^ The high praises of God shall be in their mouth: * and two-edged swords in their hands:
L.9fu: ^149:7^ To execute vengeance upon the nations, * chastisements among the people:
L.9fw: ^149:8^ To bind their kings with fetters, * and their nobles with manacles of iron.
L.9fx: ^149:9^ To execute upon them the judgment that is written: * this glory is to all his saints.
L.zfh: ^Et quandocumque terminata Hora discendum est a Choro (nisi quando immediate subsequitur Missa aut cum Officio diei Officium Defunctorum, vel Sepultura, vel Processio, aut Litaniæ, ut in Rogationibus, etc.) dicitur:^
L.xtg: ^Ant.^ Spíritus sanctus in te descéndet, María, ne tímeas, habébis in útero Fílium Dei.
L.p46: Lætífica, et ádjuva nos, omnípotens et miséricors Deus, Domínicæ Conceptiónis gáudia recoléntes, et pia Dei Génitrix Virgo semper María (in cujus veneratióne hæc commemorámus) in cunctis necessitátibus nostris grátiam sancti Spíritus nobis ímpetret, et levámen. Per eúmdem Christum Dóminum nostrum.
L.lpd: All praise, Eternal Son, to thee:
L.9d1: ^118:9^ ^(Beth)^ In quo córrigit adolescéntior viam suam? * In custodiéndo sermónes tuos.
L.99j: ^118:10^ In toto corde meo exquisívi te: * ne repéllas me a mandátis tuis.
L.99z: ^118:11^ In corde meo abscóndi elóquia tua: * ut non peccem tibi.
L.9a3: ^118:12^ Benedíctus es, Dómine: * doce me justificatiónes tuas.
L.9ab: ^118:13^ In lábiis meis, * pronuntiávi ómnia judícia oris tui.
L.9ao: ^118:14^ In via testimoniórum tuórum delectátus sum, * sicut in ómnibus divítiis.
L.9aq: ^118:15^ In mandátis tuis exercébor: * et considerábo vias tuas.
L.9b8: ^118:16^ In justificatiónibus tuis meditábor: * non oblivíscar sermónes tuos.
L.9d2: ^118:9^ ^(Béth)^ By what doth a young man correct his way? * By observing thy words.
L.99k: ^118:10^ With my whole heart have I sought after thee: * let me not stray from thy commandments.
L.9a0: ^118:11^ Thy words have I hidden in my heart, * that I may not sin against thee.
L.9a4: ^118:12^ Blessed art thou, O Lord: * teach me thy justifications.
L.9ac: ^118:13^ With my lips * I have pronounced all the judgments of thy mouth.
L.9an: ^118:14^ I have been delighted in the way of thy testimonies, * as in all riches.
L.9ap: ^118:15^ I will meditate on thy commandments: * and I will consider thy ways.
L.9b7: ^118:16^ I will think of thy justifications: * I will not forget thy words.
L.9ba: ^118:17^ ^(Ghimel)^ Retríbue servo tuo, vivífica me: * et custódiam sermónes tuos:
L.9bc: ^118:18^ Revéla óculos meos: * et considerábo mirabília de lege tua.
L.9be: ^118:19^ Íncola ego sum in terra: * non abscóndas a me mandáta tua.
L.9bf: ^118:20^ Concupívit ánima mea desideráre justificatiónes tuas, * in omni témpore.
L.9bh: ^118:21^ Increpásti supérbos: * maledícti qui declínant a mandátis tuis.
L.9bj: ^118:22^ Aufer a me oppróbrium, et contémptum: * quia testimónia tua exquisívi.
L.9bm: ^118:23^ Étenim sedérunt príncipes, et advérsum me loquebántur: * servus autem tuus exercebátur in justificatiónibus tuis.
L.9bo: ^118:24^ Nam et testimónia tua meditátio mea est: * et consílium meum justificatiónes tuæ.
L.9b9: ^118:17^ ^(Ghimel)^ Give bountifully to thy servant, enliven me * and I shall keep thy words.
L.9bb: ^118:18^ Open thou my eyes: * and I will consider the wondrous things of thy law.
L.9bd: ^118:19^ I am a sojourner on the earth: * hide not thy commandments from me.
L.9bg: ^118:20^ My soul hath coveted to long for thy justifications, * at all times.
L.9bi: ^118:21^ Thou hast rebuked the proud: * they are cursed who decline from thy commandments.
L.9bk: ^118:22^ Remove from me reproach and contempt: * because I have sought after thy testimonies.
L.9bl: ^118:23^ For princes sat, and spoke against me: * but thy servant was employed in thy justifications.
L.9bn: ^118:24^ For thy testimonies are my meditation: * and thy justifications my counsel.
L.qyo: Regi sæculórum immortáli et invisíbili, soli Deo honor et glória in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
L.114j: ^℟.^ Et líbera nos propter nomen tuum.
L.psl: Now to the king of ages, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
L.129i: ^℣.^ Arise, O Christ, and help us.
L.10r7: ^℟.^ And deliver us for thy name's sake.
L.n6l: Dómine Deus omnípotens, qui ad princípium hujus diéi nos perveníre fecísti: tua nos hódie salva virtúte; ut in hac die ad nullum declinémus peccátum, sed semper ad tuam justítiam faciéndam nostra procédant elóquia, dirigántur cogitatiónes et ópera.
L.q03: O Lord, our heavenly Father, Almighty and everlasting God, who has safely brought us to the beginning of this day: defend us by thy mighty power; and grant that this day we fall into no sin, but that all our doings may be ordered by thy governance, to do always what is righteous in thy sight.
L.zja: ^Hic expletur Prima. Deinde legitur Martyrologium in Capitulo sine benedictione. Extra Conventum non legitur Martyrologium, sed immediate incipitur Pretiósa. ut infra.^
L.zj9: ^Here Prime ends. Thereafter, the Martyrology is read in the Chapter Hall without blessing. Outside the convent, the Martyrology is not read but one immediately continues with Pretiósa. as below.^
L.r2w: Sancta María et omnes Sancti intercédant pro nobis ad Dóminum, ut nos mereámur ab eo adjuvári et salvári, qui vivit et regnat in sǽcula sæculórum.
L.12v6: ^℣.^ Precious in the sight of the Lord
L.11g0: ^℟.^ Is the death of his saints.
L.o0x: Holy Mary and all the Saints, intercede for us with the Lord, our God, so that we may merit His help and salvation, who lives and reigns for ever and ever.
L.12xp: ^℣.^ Réspice in servos tuos, Dómine, et in ópera tua, et dírige fílios eórum.
